scope: Reused anisotropic first-variation constraint and zero-shift photon Hamiltonian identities only.

anisotropic.premise: First variation on the momentarily scalar-balanced polar-areal initial slice, Pi_phi=0. Gas coordinate baryons, entropy and ionic inventory and photon canonical momenta are held fixed for the metric substep. Additional matter/packet transport is the prescribed source, not certified feedback.
anisotropic.mass: delta_m=r^2*b*Phi*f+J; J_prime+(nu_prime+lambda_prime)*J=4*pi*r^2*A^4*eF. This identity survives anisotropic radiation with its canonical-momentum response.
anisotropic.wave: U_tt/c^2-U_xx+Veff*U=Keff*J-4*pi*r*N^2*A^4*[alpha*tF+r*Phi*(eF-pF)], U=r*f, dx=dr/(N*sqrt(b)). The implemented Dphi,Dlambda and Veff are verified symbolically.
anisotropic.precision: Metric increments are independent state variables. Their being below the ulp of the full background does not make them physically zero.
anisotropic.limits: Not a nonlinear Einstein evolution, hydrodynamic stability theorem, continuum angular/spectral certificate or full response to exterior/deep-core sources.

null_transport.null_characteristics: dr/dt=c*a*mu/h; dmu/dt=(1-mu^2)*[c*a/h*(R_prime/R-a_prime/a)+mu*(R_t/R-h_t/h)]; dln(epsilon)/dt=-c*mu*a_prime/h-(h_t/h)*mu^2-(R_t/R)*(1-mu^2). Derived from the null Hamiltonian with zero shift.
null_transport.variables: Fixed Einstein radius: a=A*N, h=A/sqrt(b), R=A*r. zeta=delta_nu-delta_lambda; f=delta_phi; u=alpha*f. Existing frequency coordinate is Eref=a0(r)*epsilon.
null_transport.lapse_packet: An exterior packet of Killing energy dE at(rp,mup) contributes(G*dE/c^4)*[integral(r0,rp) dr/(N*b^(3/2)*r^2)-mup^2/(rp*Np*sqrt(bp))] to delta_nu(r0), including its compensating interior mass debit.
null_transport.scalar_lapse: delta_nu_scalar(r0)=+Phi(r0)*U(r0)-integral(r0,infinity)2*Phi*U/(r*b)dr, U=r*f. Additional vacuum J contributes -integral J/(r^2*b^2)dr.
null_transport.limits: Algebra for the declared first variation; not a nonlinear stellar or angular-continuum certificate.

characteristic.scope: Polynomial quadrature self-check only; not a continuum GR certificate.
